title: Restore settled live follow after near-bottom prompt send
outcome: A deterministic UI regression in committed HEAD c3397e8 leaves a near-bottom attached transcript without follow-up scroll after prompt send. followLatestMessageForPromptSend performs only the synchronous repin while the old multi-frame follower was removed; if scrollHeight grows after the click, no controller observes it. The focused test keeps a growing near-bottom send inside one live follow fails with followedTops.length=0 both in the current worktree and a clean HEAD worktree.
acceptance: Keep the pre-paint repin, restore bounded settled bottom-follow across later geometry growth, return/cancel its controller correctly, preserve user-detach authority, make the focused regression pass, and restore the full Vitest suite to green.
